form.label: BigFix Relay Health
form.description: Monitors upstream connectivity, gather failures, and buffer health across all BES Relays.

search.query: index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:relay" source="*logfile.txt" host="$tok_host$" ("HTTP Error" OR "Socket Error" OR "Timeout was reached" OR "Failed to connect") | eval Error_Type = case( searchmatch("*HTTP Error 28*") OR searchmatch("*Timeout was reached*"), "HTTP Timeout (Error 28)", searchmatch("*HTTP Error 6*") OR searchmatch("*Couldn't resolve host*"), "DNS / Resolution Failure (Error 6)", searchmatch("*HTTP Error 7*") OR searchmatch("*Couldn't connect to server*"), "Connection Refused (Error 7)", searchmatch("*Socket Error: Windows Error 0x2745*"), "Connection Aborted by Host (0x2745)", searchmatch("*HTTP Error 52*") OR searchmatch("*Empty reply*"), "Empty Reply / Dropped (Error 52)", 1==1, "Other Connection Error" ) | timechart span=1h count by Error_Type

drilldown.link: search?q=search index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:relay" source="*logfile.txt" host="$tok_host$" ("HTTP Error" OR "Socket Error" OR "Timeout was reached" OR "Failed to connect")&earliest=$earliest$&latest=$latest$

search.query: index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:relay" source="*logfile.txt" host="$tok_host$" ("HTTP Error" OR "Socket Error" OR "GetURL failure" OR "Uncaught exception") | stats count AS "Error Volume" by host | sort - "Error Volume"

drilldown.link: search?q=search index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:relay" source="*logfile.txt" host="$click.value$" ("HTTP Error" OR "Socket Error" OR "GetURL failure" OR "Uncaught exception")&earliest=$tok_time.earliest$&latest=$tok_time.latest$

search.query: index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:relay" source="*logfile.txt" host="$tok_host$" ("GetURL failure" OR "HTTPS connection" OR "GetExpectedVersionOfParent Error") | rex field=_raw "(?<Error_Details>(GetURL failure|HTTPS connection .* was unsuccessful|GetExpectedVersionOfParent Error).*)" | eval Error_Details=coalesce(Error_Details, _raw) | stats count by host, Error_Details | rename host AS "Relay", Error_Details AS "Gather Error", count AS "Occurrences" | sort - Occurrences

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:relay" source="*logfile.txt" host="$tok_host$" ("Disk full" OR "buffer full" OR "MaxArchiveSize" OR "FastForwardBuffer" OR "HTTP Error 23") | table _time, host, _raw | rename host AS Relay, _raw AS "Log Entry" | sort - _time

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:relay" source="*logfile.txt" host="$tok_host$" ("BES Relay shutting down" OR "BigFix Relay version") | eval Action = if(searchmatch("*shutting down*"), "Stopping", "Starting") | stats count, latest(_time) AS "Last Event" by host, Action | fieldformat "Last Event" = strftime('Last Event', "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename host AS Relay | sort - "Last Event"

drilldown.link: search?q=search index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:relay" source="*logfile.txt" host="$row.Relay$" (if("$row.Action$"=="Stopping", "BES Relay shutting down", "BigFix Relay version"))&earliest=$tok_time.earliest$&latest=$tok_time.latest$
